text_block_list.text:
Starting today is the "Summer Training Camp"—
A massive joint intensive training begins!

A chance to boost her skills ahead of the Shuka Sho.
It was enough to get anyone fired up, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, over there! We still have roll call!
Don't wander off on your own!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, look at you all fooling around...!
We did not come here to play...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The student council serves as supervisors during the summer training camp, too.
With everyone excited about the beach, it's more troublesome than usual.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, rest assured. I will never do anything
that would cut into our training time together.
choice_data_list: We've gotta make this summer camp a fruitful one!
We've gotta make this summer camp a fruitful one!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. After all, it's an irreplaceable opportunity
leading up to the Shuka Sho—”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You there! Don't enter the lodgings yet!
What class are you from?!

It seemed like it would be a busy and demanding time, but—
and so, summer training camp with Air Groove began!
